stage_summary: PR36 now includes sequenced separable followers, a complete three-state common assembly with 154/154/161 participants and independent STEP readbacks, a natively checked but still rejected EP2/FPC candidate, and executable raw hardware evidence ingestion. The 1c970e3 full run executed 1297 tests with one failed positive expectation; 4fe96be preserves the actual OPEN B-clamp collision in a 14-test bounded passing rerun. Independent selection verifies 32+1 suites across those two executions, not a single full PASS. Actual donor geometry, fabricated/powered prototypes and hosted execution remain unverified. Main remains a1b3cc1; PR35 is a separate draft; PR25 is closed without merging its old driver.

product_constraints.capacity_target_convention: sum of cell-label mAh at a common nominal reference voltage; physical series/parallel topology and actual terminal capacity remain unknown

hardware_summary: The earlier main-host v2 collection on 1c970e3 returned an empty ADB inventory; that observation is preserved with its host/time. On 2026-10-20, the already running dedicated RAZR ADB server on Pocket4 port 5061 exposes one authorized Motorola XT2551-3, matching the USB serial hash and boot hardware SKU. Readback identifies leap/SM8750 and a custom Android 17 build, 1224x2992 display reporting, goodix_ts/fts_ts input registration, and main/flip battery software design values of 3430/1140 mAh. Their 4570-mAh sum differs by 30 mAh from the Chinese OEM manual rated value 4540 mAh; the manual typical value is 4700 mAh. These are distinct software/specification values, not a physical capacity measurement or a proven 4700-mAh fit in the new layout. Board/module labels, dimensions, actual terminal pinout, cell topology and new physical assembly/powered-phone results remain open. See engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase2-20261019/hardware/pocket4-20261020/README.md.
verification_summary: The full execution on 1c970e34a72f83ac1148ed3dee11e050ed5508dd ran 33 suites / 1297 tests and FAILED: one failure, zero errors/skips, exit 1, unchanged source bytes. A bounded routing-followup repair on 4fe96be97ee64d1f4f28ba6ea09d7775030b0c6c passed 14 tests, zero failures/errors/skips. The only changed file corrects a positive test expectation to preserve three real OPEN B-clamp collisions. Independent disjoint selection verifies 32 passing suites / 1283 tests from the failed full run plus 1 suite / 14 tests from the repair: 33 suites / 1297 tests across two executions, not a single full PASS and not a geometry fix. Report: engineering/product-integration-20261018/phase2-20261019/validation/full-unit-1c970e3-report.json.gz. Independent STEP readback passed 154/154/161 common-assembly solids and 14 individual captured parts plus an 11-solid local assembly. Captured-follower checks reproduced 8 blocked original axial paths, cleared 12 declared continuous local insertion actions, and retained 5 zero-difference local reassemblies plus 7 native source comparisons. EP2 clears 190 internal pairs per end but both old/new endpoint variants remain rejected in all three phone states. The earlier main-host donor readback is empty; 2026-10-20 Pocket4 port 5061 readback now identifies the connected XT2551-3. No new-layout physical cycle or powered phone result exists. Run 39201906846 on native-execution commit 1c970e3 has 12 zero-step jobs, all with directly retrieved billing/payment-or-spend annotations; no hosted tests executed. Earlier b6abcb6 failed full execution, 3eae4e7 bounded repair and their 1240-test disjoint selection remain separate historical records. Accepted main 1187 and PR35 draft 1216 retain their own scope. Previous 8106/484/9021 mechanical checks, 64 FPC rejections and retained KiCad v4 results belong to the previous product execution and were not rerun as those same experiments.
